## Summary

A concise one-line description of the feature.

## Motivation

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve or what value does it add?

## Detailed Description

Describe the feature in detail. Include:
- Which module(s) it affects (contract, frontend, both)
- How it interacts with existing contracts or components
- Any new data structures, maps, or public functions required

## Proposed Implementation

If you have an idea how to implement it, describe it here. Pseudocode or Clarity snippets are welcome but not required.

## Alternatives Considered

What alternatives have you considered and why are you proposing this approach?

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Tests updated / added

## Additional Context

Add any other context, designs, or references here.
